domain: Identity, Access Control & Zero-Trust IAM (RBAC / MFA)
functionality: Role-based access control, restrictive default attributes, MFA, and administrative privilege separation
document_text: The platform shall enforce role-based access control (RBAC) across all subjects, objects, and operations with zero unmediated paths. It shall maintain authorized roles, bind users to roles, enforce deny-by-default security attributes, require MFA for all administrative logins, and restrict security function management exclusively to authorized security administrators.
gold_requirements: Enforce RBAC policy covering all subjects, objects, and operations with no unmediated paths.
Maintain authorized roles, associate users with roles, and enforce restrictive deny-by-default security attributes.
Require multi-factor authentication (MFA) and restrict security management to authorized administrators.
seeded_ambiguity_sample: Login should be user-friendly and reasonably secure.
seeded_conflict_sample: The system shall allow unauthenticated management access over internal APIs.
The system shall block unauthenticated management access over internal APIs.
